_comment: Words from Rhombiverse's retired world-building/game era (mining, claims, planets, planting...) that must never reach user-visible text again. scripts/verify-copy.mjs checks every user-facing string against these (case-insensitive, whole words). Add a term whenever you spot a new leftover. `allow` phrases are real geometry/chemistry wording that merely contains a term (rock salt's ionic species) and are removed before checking. `appTerms` are checked everywhere except What's New, whose older entries are left as the history they are.
allow: Sculpt, Sculpture Mode and Cyborg are gone
